title: Bloger Menia
subtitle: Django-Powered Blogging Platform with AI & Vector Search
description: A full-stack blogging platform built entirely in Django, using Jinja templates for rendering, featuring vector embedding search, curated playlists, and social integrations.

content.overview: BlogerMenia is a full-stack, developer-focused blogging and community platform built entirely in Django. Using Django Jinja templating for server-side HTML rendering, it ensures high speed and SEO optimization. The platform incorporates modern features like Vector Embeddings and AI semantic search to find articles, playlists, and users intelligently. Creators can organize their articles into step-by-step reading Playlists, sign in with LinkedIn, and directly share their published posts to LinkedIn in one click.
content.challenge: Traditional blogging platforms either lack developer-centric tools like curated reading playlists, or rely on heavy frontend JavaScript frameworks that complicate SEO and slow down initial page loads. The challenge was to build a SEO-friendly, blazing-fast, and feature-rich system using server-side rendering while delivering a highly interactive, modern UI experience.
content.solution: We built the platform entirely using Django for both frontend and backend logic. We designed Jinja templates with Tailwind CSS for clean, lightweight layouts. To implement semantic search, we leveraged AI vector embeddings and stored them in PostgreSQL using pgvector, enabling users to search topics using plain-English queries. We integrated LinkedIn OAuth for a one-click login experience and implemented a background share task via Django-Celery and LinkedIn's Share API to post directly to a user's feed upon publishing.

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content:
• Server-Side Rendering (Django Jinja Templates)
• Vector Embeddings & AI Search
• Curated Playlists for Step-by-Step Guides
• LinkedIn Login & Direct Sharing
• Interactive Sidebar & Search Suggestions
• Markdown Support with Live Preview

content.results: The server-side Jinja templates rendered pages in under 80ms. The Vector Embeddings search significantly improved query accuracy and discovery rates for related content, and the LinkedIn sharing option boosted post reach.

testimonial.text: BlogerMenia integrates vector search and playlists beautifully. Having the entire frontend and backend rendered in Django makes it extremely fast and lightweight.
testimonial.author: Jay Patel

title: Trade Buddy Broker
subtitle: Celery-Powered Algorithmic Crypto Trading & Real-time WebUI
description: Automated algorithmic trading system for cryptocurrency markets executing trades based on predefined technical setups via Delta Exchange APIs, significantly reducing manual workload and emotional stress.

content.overview: Trade Buddy Broker is an automated cryptocurrency algorithmic trading system and live monitoring dashboard. The platform utilizes custom Python scripts to continuously scan the crypto markets for predefined trade setups based on technical indicators. Once a signal is identified, the system automatically executes the trades in a non-blocking, automated manner using both paper trading and real brokerage accounts via Delta Exchange APIs. This automation has dramatically reduced manual monitoring time, improved execution accuracy, and eliminated emotional bias and mental pressure from the trading process.
content.challenge: Manual cryptocurrency trading demands 24/7 market watching, resulting in emotional decision-making, missed opportunities, and high psychological stress. Building a low-latency execution pipeline that scans multiple trading pairs, filters reliable signals, manages risk (stop-loss/take-profit), and logs real-time operations without human intervention was a critical engineering challenge.
content.solution: We designed an end-to-end automated system using Python, Pandas, and NumPy for signal generation, and Celery for distributed task queues to handle asynchronous order execution. The system connects directly to Delta Exchange APIs for paper and live trading. The Celery-powered backend ensures non-blocking, concurrent task handling and logs all algo signals, success reports, error traces, and performance stats to a unified WebUI dashboard.

sections.title: Capabilities
sections.content:
• Real-time Market Data Streaming (WebSockets)
• Predefined strategy scanning & signal generation
• Live and Paper Trading via Delta Exchange APIs
• Automated Stop-Loss & Risk Management
• Asynchronous task queuing using Celery
• Live performance, equity curves & error log dashboard

testimonial.text: Automating our strategy scans and execution via Delta Exchange and Celery has eliminated the emotional bias of manual trading. It is fast, accurate, and completely stress-free.

title: Office NJTechStudio
subtitle: Enterprise Project & Task Management
description: A comprehensive project and task management dashboard designed for NJTechStudio to organize sprints, assign tasks, track statuses, and monitor alerts.

content.overview: A dedicated project and task management dashboard designed for office workflows. It enables team members to organize tasks (Pending, In Progress, Brainstorming, Completed), manage epics, track sprints, and monitor critical alerts in a unified, intuitive dashboard interface.
content.challenge: Large teams often face communication gaps and unclear task priorities. The goal was to build a system that provides transparency and accountability without micromanagement.
content.solution: We built a scalable SaaS application with Next.js and Django. The system uses a role-based access control (RBAC) model to ensure data security and proper hierarchy management inside the organization.

sections.title: Core Modules
sections.content:
• Kanban Board for Task Management
• Sprint Planning & Backlogs
• Employee Time Tracking & Timesheets
• Automated Daily Standup Reports
• File Sharing & Document Management

content.results: Improved team velocity by 25% and reduced meeting times by leveraging the automated reporting features.

testimonial.text: This tool streamlined our entire workflow. It's clean, fast, and effective.
